card.name: Spanish verb stems like mant and respond
card.fires_on: Mostly the start of a Spanish verb split before its ending, such as 'Mant' before 'enga/ener/ienen' or 'respond' before 'en'. Also fires on a few scattered spots in English dosing text.

modes.label: Spanish verb stem
modes.description: A Spanish verb stem cut off before its ending, often in storage or keep-away-from-children advice.
modes.example: almacenar a no más de 30°C.<< Mant>>engase fuera del alcance de los

modes.label: Spanish stem in prose
modes.description: A verb stem in ordinary Spanish prose, before an ending like -en.
modes.example: podríamos comprender como las aves<< respond>>en a este tipo de cambios en el

modes.label: English dosing gaps
modes.description: Scattered points in English dosing text, such as a gap before a number or a small word like 'of' or 'with'.
modes.example: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules 0.4 mg should not be used in combination<< with>> strong inhibitors of CYP3A4

card.writes: The promoted tokens (dev, Son, Bun) show no clear link to the contexts, so there is no clear output effect.
